flags.line: - **Summary**: US inflation increased further in October, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve could continue raising interest rates into early 2027 (src_6d74390681). Financial markets have priced in a quarter-percentage-point rate hike at the Fed's December 8-9 meeting, with another increase expected in January (src_6d74390681). The FOMC kept interest rates unchanged at 3.75%-4.00% in October but maintained a hawkish stance, emphasizing the importance of bringing inflation back to the 2% target (src_4538c69c2e).
